title.narrative: Providing livelihood services to the most vulnerable women and girls in Yemen

description.narrative: Empowering women and girls at risk and enhancing the capabilities of those affected by gender-based violence by providing vocational and vocational training programs. Providing psychosocial and protection services to women and girls at risk.

Increasing the flexibility and resilience of women and girls and benefiting from gender-based violence services, with a focus on livelihood services. Sub-objectives: Empowering women and girls at risk and strengthening the capabilities of women affected by gender-based violence through vocational and vocational training programmes. Providing psychological, social and legal services to women and girls affected by gender-based violence.

Total beneficiaries: 5,200 (3,600) women and girls will receive vocational training in the training fields (sewing - hairdresser - bakery and sweets). (8) women-friendly spaces ready to receive and provide services to (1,600) women and girls.
